entries.title: Psalms 134:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Give praise to the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who take your places in the house of the Lord by night.

entries.title: Psalms 134:2
segments: Give praise to the Lord, lifting up your hands in his holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3
segments: May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, send you blessing out of Zion,
